_note: Questions, answers, articles and vote counts are REAL, harvested from the Zhihu open platform. Author profiles (nickname, label, url_token) are REAL, read from www.zhihu.com/api/v4/members. Paper metadata from Crossref and arXiv; author publication lists from ORCID, INSPIRE-HEP and the researchers' own pages. Only paper_card and user_paper_link are synthesized — the two tables Zhihu would add.

_edge_cases.arxiv:math/0211159: pre-2007 arXiv id scheme, which a naive /\d{4}\.\d{4,5}/ regex misses entirely
_edge_cases.doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0310348: real preprint/published pair with 10.1101/2024.09.01.610707 — same title, same authors, two DOIs. Verified via Crossref relation. Seeded with no discussion because none exists; it demonstrates the alias table, not a match.
_edge_cases.arXiv DOIs: 10.48550/arXiv.X is arXiv's own DataCite DOI for X. Deterministic, so aliased automatically.
_edge_cases.doi:10.1287/mnsc.2022.4522: No user_paper_link row. The author is found only through ORCID: Crossref lists 0000-0003-0541-6673 on the paper, and richard-xu-25 has bound that ORCID.
